name: change-risk-reviewer
description: Analyze product impact, write grounded stories, and review Git changes.

interface.longDescription: Map current behavior before design, recheck the repository for technical stories, then compress implemented Git changes into evidence-backed locations a human should inspect first.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this requirement against the current application and map direct and indirect impact.
Recheck the repository against the finalized design and write technical stories.
I finished a code change. Review the working diff for hidden impact.
Review committed changes from origin/main to HEAD.
Before I open this PR, tell me which changed lines deserve attention first.
